## What's new

- **"Download this video" works without playing the video.** When the page hasn't loaded a file NDM can take (nothing played yet, or a player that streams in pieces), the panel hands the page itself to NDM, which gets the video with yt-dlp, on any site, not just the known video sites. "Play the video first" is gone.
- **Turn the download panel off.** Right-click the panel: **Hide for now**, **Don't show on this site** or **Disable the download panel**. The extension now has its own options page (right-click the extension's button → **Extension options**) to turn it back on and see the sites it is hidden on; the same menu has a **Show the download panel over videos** switch.
- **Processing shows in the progress bar.** When a download needs work after the data is in (a video's picture and sound joined, a stream's pieces joined, or the file moved from the temporary folder to another drive), the bar fills again for that step with what NDM is doing and how far along it is, instead of sitting at 100 %. The list shows **Processing** with its percentage.

## Fixed

- Moving a finished file from a temporary folder on another drive no longer freezes NDM's window until it's done.
- The extension reloads itself when NDM is updated (from NDM's own copy of it), so new extension fixes arrive without reloading it by hand from now on. This once, reload it yourself: the browser's extensions page → reload.
